1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de ramas largas, delgadas y flexibles, copa densa, hojas alternas pecioladas y lampiñas, flores verdosas y fruto en drupa carnosa globosa. Rhamnaceae Zyzyphus reticulata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub with long, slender, and flexible branches, dense crown, alternate, petioled leaves that are glabrous, greenish flowers, and a fleshy, globular drupe fruit. Rhamnaceae Zyzyphus reticulata.
